questions.ar: كيف وصلت إليك هذه الفرصة الوظيفية لأول مرة؟
questions.en: Where did you first come across this particular job opportunity?
questions.condition: All outcomes; single choice
questions.action: Compare sourcing channels without confusing them with prior company awareness.
questions.source: https://www.qualtrics.com/support/employee-experience/creating-ee-project/common-use-cases-ee/candidate-experience-program/

questions.ar: قبل أن تعرف بهذه الفرصة، هل كنت قد سمعت عن ثاندر سبلاي؟
questions.en: Before learning about this vacancy, had you heard of Thunder Supply?
questions.condition: All outcomes
questions.action: Separate existing awareness from awareness created by recruitment.
questions.source: https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/20996918310555-Sample-survey-questions

questions.ar: من أين كانت لديك معلومات عن الشركة قبل هذه الفرصة؟
questions.en: Which sources had given you information about the company before this opportunity?
questions.condition: B02 = Yes; select all that apply
questions.action: Identify reputation channels. Do not request the names of individuals.
questions.source: https://www.qualtrics.com/support/employee-experience/creating-ee-project/common-use-cases-ee/candidate-experience-program/

questions.ar: بالتفكير في الفترة قبل التقديم، كيف تتذكر انطباعك عن الشركة كجهة عمل؟
questions.en: Thinking back to before you applied, how do you remember viewing the company as an employer?
questions.condition: B02 = Yes; allow No clear impression / Cannot recall
questions.action: Retrospective perception only; not a prospectively measured baseline.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: بعد تجربة التوظيف التي مررت بها، ما انطباعك الحالي عن الشركة كجهة عمل؟
questions.en: After the recruitment experience you have had, what is your current impression of the company as an employer?
questions.condition: All outcomes; allow Not enough information
questions.action: Track employer impression separately by outcome and comparable journey depth.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: ما الذي سمعته أو توقعته قبل التقديم، وكيف وافقت تجربتك ذلك أو اختلفت عنه، إن وُجد؟
questions.en: What had you heard or expected before applying, and how did your experience match or differ from that, if at all?
questions.condition: B02 = Yes; optional; do not request names
questions.action: Code themes neutrally: expectations confirmed, improved, worsened, mixed or unclear. Do not label claims false.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم سرعة تحديثك بشأن وضع طلبك خلال رحلة التوظيف؟
questions.en: How would you rate the speed of the updates you received about your application?
questions.condition: All outcomes; allow No updates received, coded separately
questions.action: Review update service levels. Missing updates are not N/A.
questions.source: https://www.surveymonkey.com/templates/candidate-experience-survey-template/

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم مدة الانتظار بين مراحل التوظيف التي مررت بها؟
questions.en: How reasonable were the waiting periods between the recruitment stages you experienced?
questions.condition: At least two stages experienced; otherwise skip
questions.action: Review stage turnaround times without assuming the cause of delay.
questions.source: https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/20996918310555-Sample-survey-questions

questions.ar: بين أي مرحلتين كان الانتظار الأكثر إزعاجًا بالنسبة لك؟
questions.en: Between which stages was the wait most frustrating for you?
questions.condition: C02 = 1 or 2; show only experienced stage transitions
questions.action: Identify the bottleneck; avoid exact dates in anonymous rejection responses.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: ما مدى سهولة إكمال طلب التقديم؟
questions.en: How easy or difficult was it to complete your application?
questions.condition: Application completed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review form length, mandatory fields and mobile experience if difficult.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, simplicity (AIHR foundations; SurveyMonkey application themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى وضوح الوصف الوظيفي والمتطلبات قبل أن تتقدّم؟
questions.en: How clear were the job description and requirements before you applied?
questions.condition: Application completed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review job-advert wording with the hiring manager.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, simplicity (AIHR foundations; SurveyMonkey application themes)

questions.ar: هل جعل أيٌّ مما يلي التقديم أصعب؟ اختر كل ما ينطبق.
questions.en: Did any of the following make applying harder? Select all that apply.
questions.condition: Application completed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Identify the most common friction points.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, simplicity (AIHR foundations; SurveyMonkey application themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى معقولية الوقت الذي استغرقه إكمال طلب التقديم؟
questions.en: How reasonable was the time needed to complete your application?
questions.condition: Application completed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review form length.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, simplicity (AIHR foundations; SurveyMonkey application themes)

questions.ar: هل وصلك ما يؤكد استلام طلبك؟
questions.en: Did you receive confirmation that your application had been received?
questions.condition: Application completed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Check that automatic acknowledgements are working.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, simplicity (AIHR foundations; SurveyMonkey application themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى وضوح الخطوات التالية والإطار الزمني المتوقع بعد التقديم؟
questions.en: How clear were you about the next steps and expected timeline after you applied?
questions.condition: Application completed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review the acknowledgement message and stated timeline.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, simplicity (AIHR foundations; SurveyMonkey application themes)

questions.ar: استطعت بسهولة إيجاد معلومات كافية عن ثقافة الشركة وقيمها قبل التقديم.
questions.en: I could easily find enough information about the company's culture and values before applying.
questions.condition: Application completed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review careers-page content on culture and values.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, simplicity (AIHR foundations; SurveyMonkey application themes)

questions.ar: ما التغيير الواحد الذي كان سيجعل التقديم أبسط أو أوضح؟
questions.en: What one change would have made applying simpler or clearer?
questions.condition: Application completed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Code themes neutrally.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, simplicity (AIHR foundations; SurveyMonkey application themes)

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم مهنية المكالمة التعريفية؟
questions.en: How would you rate the professionalism of the screening call?
questions.condition: Screening call attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review call standards with the recruiter.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, feedback (AIHR foundations; screening-call themes)

questions.ar: هل بدأت المكالمة في الوقت المتفق عليه؟
questions.en: Did the call start at the time agreed with you?
questions.condition: Screening call attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Compare with scheduling records.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, feedback (AIHR foundations; screening-call themes)

questions.ar: أي من المواضيع التالية تم شرحها بوضوح خلال المكالمة؟ اختر كل ما ينطبق.
questions.en: Which of these topics were explained clearly during the call? Select all that apply.
questions.condition: Screening call attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Check the screening-call script covers every topic.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, feedback (AIHR foundations; screening-call themes)

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم الطريقة التي نوقش بها راتبك المتوقع؟
questions.en: How would you rate the way your salary expectations were discussed?
questions.condition: Screening call attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review how salary expectations are raised and explained.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, feedback (AIHR foundations; screening-call themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى وضوح التعليمات الخاصة بجزء اللغة الإنجليزية في المكالمة؟
questions.en: How clear were the instructions for the English-language part of the call?
questions.condition: Screening call attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review how the English check is introduced.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, feedback (AIHR foundations; screening-call themes)

questions.ar: ما مقدار الفرصة التي أُتيحت لك لطرح أسئلتك؟
questions.en: How much opportunity did you have to ask your own questions?
questions.condition: Screening call attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Leave time for candidate questions.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, feedback (AIHR foundations; screening-call themes)

questions.ar: بعد المكالمة، كم انتظرت حتى وصلك أي خبر عن الخطوة التالية؟
questions.en: After the call, how long did you wait to hear about the next step?
questions.condition: Screening call attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Compare with actual turnaround records.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, feedback (AIHR foundations; screening-call themes)

questions.ar: ما الذي يمكننا تحسينه في المكالمة التعريفية؟
questions.en: What could we improve about the screening call?
questions.condition: Screening call attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Code themes neutrally.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, feedback (AIHR foundations; screening-call themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى استعداد المحاورين لمقابلتك؟
questions.en: How prepared were the interviewers for your interview?
questions.condition: HR interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Brief interviewers on the candidate profile beforehand.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Interviewer preparedness, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى وضوح وصف المحاورين للدور ومسؤولياته؟
questions.en: How clearly did the interviewers describe the role and its responsibilities?
questions.condition: HR interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Align the role briefing used in interviews.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Interviewer preparedness, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مقدار الفرصة التي أُتيحت لك لعرض خبرتك ونقاط قوتك؟
questions.en: How much opportunity did you have to present your experience and strengths?
questions.condition: HR interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review interview structure and question time.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Interviewer preparedness, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: هل توفّر لك وقت كافٍ لطرح أسئلتك؟
questions.en: Did you have enough time to ask your own questions?
questions.condition: HR interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Reserve time for candidate questions.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Interviewer preparedness, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: هل بدأت المقابلة في الوقت الذي أُبلغت به؟
questions.en: Did the interview start at the time communicated to you?
questions.condition: HR interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Compare with scheduling records.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Interviewer preparedness, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى شعورك بالراحة لتكون على طبيعتك خلال المقابلة؟
questions.en: How comfortable did you feel being yourself during the interview?
questions.condition: HR interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review interview opening and setting.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Interviewer preparedness, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: بعد المقابلة، أصبحت أفهم قيم الشركة وطريقة عملها.
questions.en: After the interview, I understand the company's values and way of working.
questions.condition: HR interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review how values are communicated in interviews.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Interviewer preparedness, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: أكمل الجملة: كنت سأقدّم أداءً أفضل في هذه المقابلة لو…
questions.en: Complete this sentence: I would have performed better in this interview if…
questions.condition: HR interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Code themes neutrally.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Interviewer preparedness, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى ارتباط الأسئلة التقنية بالعمل المتوقع في هذا الدور؟
questions.en: How closely did the technical questions relate to the work expected in the role?
questions.condition: Technical interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review the technical question set against role competencies.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Relevance, opportunity to demonstrate skills (SurveyMonkey / Greenhouse interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مقدار الفرصة التي أُتيحت لك لإظهار مهاراتك بأمثلة حقيقية؟
questions.en: How much opportunity did you have to demonstrate your skills with real examples?
questions.condition: Technical interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review competency coverage.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Relevance, opportunity to demonstrate skills (SurveyMonkey / Greenhouse interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى وضوح الأسئلة التي طرحتها اللجنة عليك؟
questions.en: How clear were the questions the panel asked you?
questions.condition: Technical interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review question wording and jargon.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Relevance, opportunity to demonstrate skills (SurveyMonkey / Greenhouse interview themes)

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم تنسيق اللجنة فيما بينها (تبادل الأدوار وعدم تكرار الأسئلة)؟
questions.en: How well coordinated was the panel (taking turns, not repeating questions)?
questions.condition: Technical interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Agree panel roles before the interview.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Relevance, opportunity to demonstrate skills (SurveyMonkey / Greenhouse interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى استعداد اللجنة، مثل اطلاعها على سيرتك الذاتية؟
questions.en: How prepared did the panel seem, for example familiar with your CV?
questions.condition: Technical interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Share candidate files with the panel beforehand.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Relevance, opportunity to demonstrate skills (SurveyMonkey / Greenhouse interview themes)

questions.ar: هل بدا لك أي شيء في هذه المقابلة غير عادل أو غير لائق؟
questions.en: Did anything in this interview feel unfair or inappropriate?
questions.condition: Technical interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: HR to review; do not assume misconduct and do not rank individuals from small samples.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Relevance, opportunity to demonstrate skills (SurveyMonkey / Greenhouse interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى كفاية الوقت المتاح لك للإجابة عن كل سؤال؟
questions.en: How sufficient was the time you had to answer each question?
questions.condition: Technical interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review interview timing.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Relevance, opportunity to demonstrate skills (SurveyMonkey / Greenhouse interview themes)

questions.ar: هل من شيء آخر تودّ مشاركته، بما في ذلك ما بدا غير عادل أو غير لائق إن أجبت بنعم؟ يُرجى عدم ذكر أسماء.
questions.en: Anything else to share, including what felt unfair or inappropriate if you answered Yes above? Please avoid names.
questions.condition: Technical interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Code themes neutrally; protect identities.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Relevance, opportunity to demonstrate skills (SurveyMonkey / Greenhouse interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى وضوح تعليمات الاختبار؟
questions.en: How clear were the assessment instructions?
questions.condition: Assessment attempted; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Rewrite instructions and test them with a colleague.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Simplicity, fairness, reasonable assessments (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: ما مدى معقولية الوقت الذي تطلّبه الاختبار؟
questions.en: How reasonable was the time commitment the assessment required?
questions.condition: Assessment attempted; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review task length with the hiring manager.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Simplicity, fairness, reasonable assessments (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: ما مدى مطابقة مهام الاختبار للدور كما فهمته؟
questions.en: How closely did the assessment tasks match the role as you understood it?
questions.condition: Assessment attempted; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review assessment content against role requirements.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Simplicity, fairness, reasonable assessments (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: هل أعاقك أي مما يلي؟ اختر كل ما ينطبق.
questions.en: Did any of the following hinder you? Select all that apply.
questions.condition: Assessment attempted; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review technical and accessibility barriers.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Simplicity, fairness, reasonable assessments (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: هل أُخبرت مسبقًا بمحتوى الاختبار ومدته؟
questions.en: Were you told in advance what the assessment would cover and how long it would take?
questions.condition: Assessment attempted; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Add content and duration to the invitation.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Simplicity, fairness, reasonable assessments (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: أتاح لي الاختبار فرصة عادلة لإظهار قدراتي.
questions.en: The assessment gave me a fair chance to show my abilities.
questions.condition: Assessment attempted; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review fairness of the assessment design.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Simplicity, fairness, reasonable assessments (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: بعد الاختبار، كم انتظرت لمعرفة الخطوة التالية؟
questions.en: After the assessment, how long did you wait to hear what happens next?
questions.condition: Assessment attempted; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Compare with actual turnaround records.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Simplicity, fairness, reasonable assessments (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: ما الذي كنت ستغيّره في الاختبار؟
questions.en: What would you change about the assessment?
questions.condition: Assessment attempted; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Code themes neutrally.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Simplicity, fairness, reasonable assessments (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: ما مقدار الفرصة التي أُتيحت لك لاستخدام أمثلة حقيقية من خبرتك؟
questions.en: How much opportunity did you have to use real examples from your experience?
questions.condition: Final behavioral interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Calibrate behavioral probes.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Panel coordination, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم تنسيق أعضاء اللجنة أثناء النقاش؟
questions.en: How well coordinated was the panel during the discussion?
questions.condition: Final behavioral interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Agree panel roles for large panels.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Panel coordination, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى وضوح الأسئلة السلوكية التي طُرحت عليك؟
questions.en: How clear were the behavioral questions you were asked?
questions.condition: Final behavioral interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review question wording.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Panel coordination, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى كفاية الوقت المتاح لك للتفكير والإجابة؟
questions.en: How sufficient was the time you had to think and answer?
questions.condition: Final behavioral interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Allow sufficient answer time.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Panel coordination, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى شعورك بالراحة لتكون على طبيعتك أمام اللجنة؟
questions.en: How comfortable did you feel being yourself in front of the panel?
questions.condition: Final behavioral interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review panel size and opening.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Panel coordination, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: خرجت بصورة واضحة عن الدور والفريق وما هو متوقع.
questions.en: I finished with a clear picture of the role, the team and what is expected.
questions.condition: Final behavioral interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review closing briefing.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Panel coordination, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: هل بدا لك أي شيء في هذه المقابلة غير عادل أو غير لائق؟
questions.en: Did anything in this interview feel unfair or inappropriate?
questions.condition: Final behavioral interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: HR to review; do not assume misconduct and do not rank individuals from small samples.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Panel coordination, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: ما الشيء الواحد الذي كان سيحسّن مقابلتك النهائية؟
questions.en: What one thing would have improved your final interview?
questions.condition: Final behavioral interview attended; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Code themes neutrally.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Panel coordination, inclusion (SurveyMonkey interview themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى وضوح الغرض من التحقق من المرجعيات والخلفية؟
questions.en: How clear was the purpose of the reference and background checks?
questions.condition: Reference / background checks reached; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Explain purpose in the request message.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, respect for personal information (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: ما مدى وضوح المعلومات والمستندات المطلوبة منك؟
questions.en: How clear was the information and documents you were asked to provide?
questions.condition: Reference / background checks reached; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Provide a clear checklist.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, respect for personal information (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: ما مدى معقولية الجهد المطلوب لتقديمها؟
questions.en: How reasonable was the effort needed to provide it?
questions.condition: Reference / background checks reached; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review the volume of information requested.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, respect for personal information (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: هل أُبلغت قبل التواصل مع مرجعياتك؟
questions.en: Were you informed before your references were contacted?
questions.condition: Reference / background checks reached; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Always inform candidates before contacting references.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, respect for personal information (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: شعرت أن معلوماتي الشخصية عُوملت باحترام وعناية.
questions.en: I felt my personal information was handled with respect and care.
questions.condition: Reference / background checks reached; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review handling and communication of personal data.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, respect for personal information (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم التحديثات التي وصلتك أثناء إجراء التحقق؟
questions.en: How would you rate the updates you received while the checks were in progress?
questions.condition: Reference / background checks reached; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Agree an update schedule.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, respect for personal information (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: مقارنة بتوقعاتك، كم استغرق التحقق؟
questions.en: Compared with what you expected, how long did the checks take?
questions.condition: Reference / background checks reached; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Communicate expected duration up front.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, respect for personal information (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: ما الذي يمكننا تحسينه في عملية التحقق من المرجعيات والخلفية؟
questions.en: What could we improve about the reference and background check process?
questions.condition: Reference / background checks reached; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Code themes neutrally.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Transparency, respect for personal information (AIHR foundations)

questions.ar: ما مدى وضوح شروط العرض الوظيفي؟
questions.en: How clear were the terms of the offer?
questions.condition: Offer signed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review the offer explanation and provide a checklist of terms.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, expectation match (Qualtrics / AIHR themes)

questions.ar: هل وجدت في العرض اختلافًا مهمًا عما فهمته من المناقشات السابقة؟
questions.en: Did the offer contain any important difference from what you understood from earlier discussions?
questions.condition: Offer signed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review expectation mismatches; do not treat every difference as a breach.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, expectation match (Qualtrics / AIHR themes)

questions.ar: ما مدى معقولية المهلة التي مُنحت لك لمراجعة العرض واتخاذ القرار؟
questions.en: How reasonable was the time you were given to review the offer and decide?
questions.condition: Offer signed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review the standard decision window.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, expectation match (Qualtrics / AIHR themes)

questions.ar: أي أجزاء من العرض احتاجت إلى توضيح أكثر؟ اختر كل ما ينطبق.
questions.en: Which parts of the offer needed more clarification? Select all that apply.
questions.condition: Offer signed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Identify which terms need clearer explanation.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, expectation match (Qualtrics / AIHR themes)

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم الطريقة التي قُدّم بها العرض إليك؟
questions.en: How would you rate the way the offer was delivered to you?
questions.condition: Offer signed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Review offer delivery and tone.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, expectation match (Qualtrics / AIHR themes)

questions.ar: أعرف ما الذي سيحدث بين توقيع العرض ويوم مباشرتي.
questions.en: I know what will happen between signing and my first day.
questions.condition: Offer signed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Send a clear pre-boarding checklist.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, expectation match (Qualtrics / AIHR themes)

questions.ar: هل تطابقت تجربة التوظيف مع ما قيل لك عن الشركة؟
questions.en: Did the hiring process match what you had been told about the company?
questions.condition: Offer signed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Compare employer-brand promise with experience.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, expectation match (Qualtrics / AIHR themes)

questions.ar: ما أكثر ما أثّر في قرارك بالقبول، وما الذي يمكننا تحسينه في مرحلة العرض؟
questions.en: What mattered most in your decision to accept, and what could we do better at the offer stage?
questions.condition: Offer signed; one of 8 questions in this stage block
questions.action: Code themes neutrally.
questions.source: Original wording; theme: Clarity, expectation match (Qualtrics / AIHR themes)

questions.ar: ما السبب الرئيسي الذي دفعك لعدم الاستمرار في هذه الفرصة؟
questions.en: What was the main reason you decided not to continue with this opportunity?
questions.condition: Withdrawn only; single main reason; permit Prefer not to say
questions.action: Separate process-related withdrawal from role fit, competing offers and personal circumstances.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: هل كان هناك تغيير واقعي من جانبنا كان سيجعلك تفكر في الاستمرار؟
questions.en: Was there a realistic change on our side that might have made you consider continuing?
questions.condition: Withdrawn only; optional; accept No
questions.action: Review avoidable losses without promising a revised offer or reopening the process.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: هل ترغب أن يتواصل معك فريق الموارد البشرية لفهم ملاحظاتك بشكل أفضل؟
questions.en: Would you like HR to contact you to understand your feedback better?
questions.condition: Withdrawn only; answers are identified; follow-up is optional
questions.action: Follow up only if requested; do not turn consent into compulsory contact.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: كيف تقيّم احترام الصياغة المستخدمة لإبلاغك بعدم الاستمرار؟
questions.en: How would you rate the respectfulness of the message informing you that your application would not progress?
questions.condition: Rejection message actually sent; anonymous response path
questions.action: Review rejection wording and tone; do not rate satisfaction with the rejection decision itself.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: إلى أي درجة كانت نتيجة طلبك واضحة في رسالة الرفض؟
questions.en: How clearly did the rejection message communicate the outcome of your application?
questions.condition: Rejection sent only
questions.action: Remove vague closure wording without promising individual feedback.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: ما الذي كان سيجعل طريقة إنهاء التواصل معك أفضل؟
questions.en: What could have improved the way we concluded communication with you?
questions.condition: Rejection sent only; optional; remind candidate not to identify themselves
questions.action: Improve closure practice; never attempt to re-identify the respondent.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: ما العامل الأكثر تأثيرًا في قرارك قبول العرض؟
questions.en: Which factor had the greatest influence on your decision to accept the offer?
questions.condition: Offer signed only; one primary factor
questions.action: Compare attraction factors with the employer proposition; not an onboarding satisfaction measure.
questions.source: https://www.qualtrics.com/support/employee-experience/creating-ee-project/common-use-cases-ee/candidate-experience-program/

questions.ar: هل بقي موضوع متعلق بالعرض تحتاج إلى توضيحه قبل المباشرة؟
questions.en: Is there anything about the offer you still need clarified before starting?
questions.condition: Offer signed only; identified response; optional
questions.action: Ask HR to clarify outstanding offer matters before the start date.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

questions.ar: بشكل عام، ما مدى رضاك عن تجربة التوظيف التي مررت بها معنا؟
questions.en: Overall, how satisfied are you with the recruitment experience you had with us?
questions.condition: All outcomes; completed experience only
questions.action: Track overall experience separately from the hiring decision.
questions.source: https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/employee-feedback/candidate-experience-survey/

questions.ar: استنادًا إلى تجربتك، ما مدى احتمال أن تنصح شخصًا مناسبًا بالتقديم إلى الشركة؟
questions.en: Based on your experience, how likely are you to encourage a suitable person to apply to the company?
questions.condition: All outcomes; optional answer / Cannot judge
questions.action: Optional candidate advocacy score: %9–10 minus %0–6. Not eNPS and no external benchmark claimed.
questions.source: https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/employee-feedback/candidate-experience-survey/

questions.ar: إذا توفرت فرصة مناسبة مستقبلًا، ما مدى استعدادك للنظر في التقديم إلينا؟
questions.en: If a suitable opportunity became available later, how willing would you be to consider applying to us?
questions.condition: Withdrawn / rejection only; exclude signed hires
questions.action: Understand future consideration without conflating it with current offer acceptance.
questions.source: https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/20996918310555-Sample-survey-questions

questions.ar: ما التغيير الواحد الذي كان سيحسّن تجربتك معنا أكثر من غيره؟
questions.en: What one change would have made the biggest improvement to your experience with us?
questions.condition: All outcomes; optional response
questions.action: Prioritize recurring process issues; HR reviews comments in context.
questions.source: User requirements / original design

QUALITY.ar: 1 سيئ جدًا | 2 سيئ | 3 مقبول | 4 جيد | 5 ممتاز
QUALITY.en: 1 Very poor | 2 Poor | 3 Acceptable | 4 Good | 5 Excellent
QUALITY.notes: N/A / Cannot recall where appropriate. C01 additionally has No updates received; do not treat that as N/A.

CLARITY.ar: 1 غير واضح إطلاقًا | 2 غير واضح إلى حد كبير | 3 واضح جزئيًا | 4 واضح | 5 واضح تمامًا
CLARITY.en: 1 Not at all clear | 2 Mostly unclear | 3 Partly clear | 4 Clear | 5 Completely clear

EASE.ar: 1 صعب جدًا | 2 صعب | 3 لا سهل ولا صعب | 4 سهل | 5 سهل جدًا
EASE.en: 1 Very difficult | 2 Difficult | 3 Neither easy nor difficult | 4 Easy | 5 Very easy
EASE.notes: Not applicable if no application form was completed.

IMPRESSION.ar: 1 سلبي جدًا | 2 سلبي | 3 محايد | 4 إيجابي | 5 إيجابي جدًا
IMPRESSION.en: 1 Very negative | 2 Negative | 3 Neutral | 4 Positive | 5 Very positive
IMPRESSION.notes: Separate: No clear impression / Cannot recall (before); Not enough information (after). Never code as neutral.

OPPORTUNITY.ar: 1 لا فرصة إطلاقًا | 2 فرصة قليلة | 3 فرصة متوسطة | 4 فرصة كبيرة | 5 فرصة كبيرة جدًا
OPPORTUNITY.en: 1 None | 2 A little | 3 A moderate amount | 4 A lot | 5 A great deal

RELEVANCE.ar: 1 غير مرتبط إطلاقًا | 2 ارتباط ضعيف | 3 ارتباط متوسط | 4 مرتبط بدرجة كبيرة | 5 مرتبط تمامًا
RELEVANCE.en: 1 Not at all related | 2 Slightly related | 3 Moderately related | 4 Very related | 5 Completely related

REASONABLENESS.ar: 1 غير مناسب إطلاقًا | 2 غير مناسب غالبًا | 3 مناسب جزئيًا | 4 مناسب | 5 مناسب جدًا
REASONABLENESS.en: 1 Very unreasonable | 2 Unreasonable | 3 Partly reasonable | 4 Reasonable | 5 Very reasonable

SUFFICIENCY.ar: 1 غير كافٍ إطلاقًا | 2 غير كافٍ غالبًا | 3 كافٍ جزئيًا | 4 كافٍ | 5 كافٍ تمامًا
SUFFICIENCY.en: 1 Not at all sufficient | 2 Mostly insufficient | 3 Partly sufficient | 4 Sufficient | 5 Fully sufficient

SATISFACTION.ar: 1 غير راضٍ جدًا | 2 غير راضٍ | 3 لا راضٍ ولا غير راضٍ | 4 راضٍ | 5 راضٍ جدًا
SATISFACTION.en: 1 Very dissatisfied | 2 Dissatisfied | 3 Neither satisfied nor dissatisfied | 4 Satisfied | 5 Very satisfied

LIKELIHOOD_0_10.ar: 0 غير محتمل إطلاقًا إلى 10 محتمل للغاية
LIKELIHOOD_0_10.en: 0 Not at all likely to 10 Extremely likely
LIKELIHOOD_0_10.notes: Cannot judge / Prefer not to answer; exclude these from calculation.

WILLINGNESS.ar: 1 غير مستعد إطلاقًا | 2 غير مستعد | 3 غير متأكد | 4 مستعد | 5 مستعد جدًا
WILLINGNESS.en: 1 Very unwilling | 2 Unwilling | 3 Unsure | 4 Willing | 5 Very willing

YES_NO_UNSURE.notes: If not Yes, skip prior reputation detail.

YES_NO_PREFER_NOT.en: Yes | No | Prefer not to answer
YES_NO_PREFER_NOT.notes: If Yes, allow an optional comment without identifying details.

JOB_SOURCE.ar: LinkedIn | موقع الشركة | منصة وظائف | ترشيح موظف | معرفة شخصية | وكالة توظيف | تواصل مباشر من الشركة | نقابة/جامعة/فعالية | مصدر آخر | لا أتذكر
JOB_SOURCE.en: LinkedIn | Company careers site | Job board | Employee referral | Personal contact | Recruitment agency | Direct outreach from the company | Association/university/event | Other | Cannot recall
JOB_SOURCE.notes: Single choice; if Job board, optionally choose Bayt / Akhtaboot / other. No referrer names.

REPUTATION_SOURCES.ar: موظفون حاليون | موظفون سابقون | معارف | LinkedIn | موقع الشركة | مواقع تقييم أصحاب العمل | أخبار/فعاليات مهنية | مصدر آخر | لا أتذكر
REPUTATION_SOURCES.en: Current employees | Former employees | Personal contacts | LinkedIn | Company website | Employer review sites | News/professional events | Other | Cannot recall
REPUTATION_SOURCES.notes: Multiple choice. Do not ask who said what by name.

ASSESSMENT_BARRIER.ar: لا عوائق | مشكلة تقنية | تعليمات غير واضحة | صعوبة في ترتيب الوقت | حاجة لدعم في الوصول | عائق آخر | أفضل عدم الإجابة
ASSESSMENT_BARRIER.en: No barriers | Technical issue | Unclear instructions | Scheduling difficulty | Accessibility support needed | Other | Prefer not to answer
ASSESSMENT_BARRIER.notes: Multiple choice; No barriers and Prefer not to answer are exclusive. Do not request medical details.

STAGE_GAP.ar: التقديم–المكالمة | المكالمة–HR | HR–التقنية | التقنية–الاختبار | الاختبار–النهائية | النهائية–التحقق | التحقق–القرار | أخرى | لا أتذكر
STAGE_GAP.en: Application–screening | Screening–HR | HR–technical | Technical–assessment | Assessment–final | Final–checks | Checks–decision | Other | Cannot recall
STAGE_GAP.notes: Only show transitions actually experienced; allow gaps caused by skipped stages.

OFFER_DIFFERENCE.ar: نعم | لا | غير متأكد | أفضل عدم الإجابة
OFFER_DIFFERENCE.en: Yes | No | Unsure | Prefer not to answer
OFFER_DIFFERENCE.notes: If Yes: optional comment. No salary amounts required.

WITHDRAWAL_REASON.ar: قبول فرصة أخرى | الراتب/المزايا المتوقعة | عدم ملاءمة الدور | الموقع/نمط العمل | مدة الإجراءات | التواصل | تجربة مقابلة | متطلبات الاختبار | انطباعي عن الشركة | ظروف شخصية | سبب آخر | أفضل عدم الإجابة
WITHDRAWAL_REASON.en: Accepted another opportunity | Expected pay/benefits | Role fit | Location/work arrangement | Process duration | Communication | Interview experience | Assessment requirements | Impression of the company | Personal circumstances | Other | Prefer not to answer
WITHDRAWAL_REASON.notes: Single primary reason; optional secondary reasons should be analysed separately.

ACCEPTANCE_REASON.ar: طبيعة الدور | التعويضات | فرص التطور | الانطباع عن المدير/الفريق | سمعة الشركة | الموقع/نمط العمل | تجربة التوظيف | عامل آخر | أفضل عدم الإجابة
ACCEPTANCE_REASON.en: Role itself | Compensation | Development prospects | Impression of manager/team | Company reputation | Location/work arrangement | Recruitment experience | Other | Prefer not to answer

TEXT.ar: إجابة اختيارية؛ لا تذكر أسماء أو تفاصيل تكشف هويتك في مسار الرفض
TEXT.en: Optional free text; do not include names or identifying details in the rejection pathway
TEXT.notes: Do not require comments or automatically infer truth, motive or misconduct from them.

PREPARED.ar: 1 غير مستعدين إطلاقًا | 2 غير مستعدين غالبًا | 3 مستعدون جزئيًا | 4 مستعدون | 5 مستعدون تمامًا
PREPARED.en: 1 Not at all prepared | 2 Mostly unprepared | 3 Partly prepared | 4 Prepared | 5 Fully prepared

AGREEMENT.ar: 1 لا أوافق إطلاقًا | 2 لا أوافق | 3 محايد | 4 أوافق | 5 أوافق بشدة
AGREEMENT.en: 1 Strongly disagree | 2 Disagree | 3 Neither agree nor disagree | 4 Agree | 5 Strongly agree

COMFORT.ar: 1 غير مرتاح إطلاقًا | 2 غير مرتاح | 3 محايد | 4 مرتاح | 5 مرتاح جدًا
COMFORT.en: 1 Very uncomfortable | 2 Uncomfortable | 3 Neutral | 4 Comfortable | 5 Very comfortable

TIMING_START.ar: في الموعد تمامًا | تأخر أقل من 10 دقائق | تأخر من 10 إلى 30 دقيقة | تأخر أكثر من 30 دقيقة
TIMING_START.en: On time | Less than 10 minutes late | 10 to 30 minutes late | More than 30 minutes late
TIMING_START.notes: Compare with scheduling records; Cannot recall is added automatically.

WAIT_TIME.ar: في اليوم نفسه | من 1 إلى 3 أيام | من 4 إلى 7 أيام | أكثر من أسبوع | لم يصلني رد
WAIT_TIME.en: Same day | 1 to 3 days | 4 to 7 days | More than a week | I never heard back

EXPECTED_DURATION.ar: أقصر مما توقعت | كما توقعت تقريبًا | أطول مما توقعت | لم تكن لدي توقعات
EXPECTED_DURATION.en: Shorter than expected | About what I expected | Longer than expected | I had no expectation

APPLICATION_FRICTION_MULTI.ar: نموذج تقديم طويل | إعادة إدخال بيانات موجودة في سيرتي الذاتية | أخطاء تقنية أو بطء المنصة | مشاكل في رفع المستندات | صعوبة الاستخدام على الهاتف | متطلبات غير واضحة | لم يجعل شيء التقديم أصعب | أخرى
APPLICATION_FRICTION_MULTI.en: Long application form | Re-entering details already in my CV | Technical errors or slow platform | Problems uploading documents | Hard to use on my phone | Unclear requirements | Nothing made it harder | Other

SCREENING_TOPICS_MULTI.ar: الدور والمسؤوليات | آلية مناقشة الراتب المتوقع | ساعات العمل والموقع | مراحل التوظيف القادمة | نبذة عن الشركة | لا شيء مما سبق
SCREENING_TOPICS_MULTI.en: The role and responsibilities | How salary expectations are handled | Working hours and location | The hiring steps ahead | About the company | None of these

ASSESSMENT_BARRIER_MULTI.ar: لا عوائق | مشكلة تقنية | تعليمات غير واضحة | صعوبة في تنظيم الوقت | حاجة لدعم في إمكانية الوصول | عائق آخر
ASSESSMENT_BARRIER_MULTI.en: No barriers | Technical issue | Unclear instructions | Difficulty finding the time | Needed accessibility support | Other

OFFER_CLARIFY_MULTI.ar: الراتب | المزايا | تاريخ المباشرة | ساعات العمل | فترة التجربة | المسمى الوظيفي والمهام | لم يحتج شيء إلى توضيح | أخرى
OFFER_CLARIFY_MULTI.en: Salary | Benefits | Start date | Working hours | Probation period | Job title and duties | Nothing needed clarification | Other
